input.summary: Add IP/data clause: Kubient keeps generic tools and platform; AP gets perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to deliverables with modification and sublicensing rights; Kubient's licence to AP data limited to providing the Services.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no ownership or IP clause, so we have no rights in Kubient's deliverables and no limit on Kubient's use of our content and data. We have added our fallback position: Kubient keeps its generic tools, know-how and the Auction Platform, we receive a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables for our business, and any Kubient licence in our data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.

ops.text: Kubient retains ownership of its generic tools, know-how and the Auction Platform. Kubient hereby grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the deliverables and products delivered hereunder for Customer's business. Any license granted to Kubient in the Content or in any other data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
